name: Card payment on the provider page issues a receipt
title: SC-09-04-04 Card payment on the provider page issues a receipt
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a resident has an open dues item
When the resident pays by card on the provider page
Then a receipt is issued for the payment
